name: Additional options
descr: The registry of the additional options: what may be hung on the rows of an entity - sections, attributes, brands, suppliers and their warehouses, parameters and their values, people, groups of people, promo blocks, filters and tax areas. Every call names its place, and the answer is the tree of the options declared there with the values every one of them keeps. Setting an option on a row of an entity is not done here: the tool of that family writes its own *_key_set and takes key_id and value_id from this one. An option is addressed by its skey, in a module as in the program, so two of one name in one place are refused.

commands.name: CmdList
commands.descr: Reads the options declared for one place and every value they keep - two tables. The tree comes whole: a registry of a shop is small, and key_id with value_id are filled from it.

params.name: place
params.descr: the entity the options belong to: advert, brand, info, param, param_value, provider, provider_stock, tax_area, topic, topic_filter, user, user_group

commands.name: CmdKeyAdd
commands.descr: Declares an option in one place, under a parent - 0 puts it at the top of the tree. A folder only groups others and keeps no values of its own.

params.name: place
params.descr: the entity the options belong to: advert, brand, info, param, param_value, provider, provider_stock, tax_area, topic, topic_filter, user, user_group

params.name: parent_id
params.descr: id of the option it goes under; 0 puts it at the top of the tree

params.name: skey
params.descr: the symbolic name a module and the program address the option by, its own in this place

params.name: name
params.descr: the name shown in the option panel of the entity

params.name: folder
params.descr: true - a folder that only groups others, it keeps no values itself

params.name: descr
params.descr: the description shown beside the option

params.name: mask_edit
params.descr: the entry mask of the value; with a mask the editor takes a masked value, without one plain words

commands.descr: Deletes options by id, with the branch under them, their values and the rows of the entities standing on them. The first call counts what goes, the second one does it.

commands.name: CmdValueAdd
commands.descr: Adds a value to an option, at the end of its list. An option keeping no values is filled in by hand or by its mask; one keeping them becomes a list to pick from.

commands.name: CmdValuePos
commands.descr: Lays the values of one option in order.

params.name: place
params.descr: the entity the options belong to: advert, brand, info, param, param_value, provider, provider_stock, tax_area, topic, topic_filter, user, user_group

params.name: key_id
params.descr: id of the option whose values are put in order

params.name: type
params.descr: POS - the rows given go to the front in that order; MOVE - one row shifts by so many places, minus upwards; SORT - the whole list is laid out by a column

params.name: data
params.descr: the payload of that type: [{"id": 22}] for POS, [{"id": 22, "inc": -5}] for MOVE - inc is how many places it shifts, minus upwards - and {"field": "name", "direction": "ASC"} for SORT
